text.text: Each piece grants +3 armor, +1 armor toughness, and +100% knockback resistance. Helmet: Grants the shared stat bonuses only. Chestplate: At half health or lower, triggers an Annihilation Supernova and grants 3 seconds of invulnerability. Leggings: Critical hits have a 25% chance to deal armor-bypassing area damage equal to half the current weapon damage. Boots: Protect against Weakness and Slowness.
